database_engine.postgresql_version_assumptions: PostgreSQL 15+ (uses JSONB, TIMESTAMPTZ, UUID, ARRAY, partial indexes, and advisory locks)

transaction_and_session_lifecycle.request_session_scope: Per-request generator dependency (yield db; finally db.close())
transaction_and_session_lifecycle.request_commit_policy: Explicit commit in domain services or router handlers; get_db() does NOT auto-commit on exit
transaction_and_session_lifecycle.request_rollback_policy: Explicit rollback in exception handlers or manual service try/except blocks; get_db() closes session without unconditional rollback on uncaught exceptions
transaction_and_session_lifecycle.background_worker_sessions: Direct instantiation of SessionLocal() per task/job in background worker loops
transaction_and_session_lifecycle.cli_admin_sessions: Standalone SessionLocal() instantiation in scripts/ and management commands

alembic_configuration.sqlite_use_alter_filter: foreign_key_constraint with use_alter is filtered on SQLite

test_database_architecture.test_db_isolation: In-memory SQLite with StaticPool or separate test.db
test_database_architecture.test_discrepancy_risk: CRITICAL RISK: Base.metadata.create_all() creates tables directly from ORM definitions, bypassing Alembic migrations entirely during test execution, hiding missing Alembic migration scripts.
